source_note: Farmed from the kenyanstocks.com statement API on 2026-09-21. Every cell is computed: line items carried from the source (0 where absent), group subtotals and statement totals computed by identity. No blanks.
name: Express Kenya

rows.label: Non-current Assets
rows.derivedFrom: Non-current Assets = sum of the filed non-current asset lines
rows.identityAgreement: component sum equals the filed total

rows.label: Current Assets
rows.derivedFrom: Current Assets = sum of the filed current asset lines
rows.identityAgreement: component sum equals the filed total

reconciliation_note: Total Equity computed as Total assets - Total liabilities

periodAlignment.note: this statement and its counterpart cover different periods; pair them by period label, never by array index (see bot/statements.py::pkey)

derivation.componentSplit: components summed from the filed line items, each classified by its own group and an explicit current or non-current marker

corrections_note: NSE source-certified balance row. This period's total-equity row is added from the dated source named in `corrections`, so the P/B stands on the period the valuation names instead of on an older year's book value under a current label. Every other row is left blank for this period: the source publishes the equity alone here, and a blank is honest where a guessed asset or liability is not. Carried in bot/statements.py (NSE_SOURCE_CERTIFIED) as well.

corrections.source: StockAnalysis, exchange slug nase (S&P Global Market Intelligence), read 2026-10-13, against the issuers' own filings
corrections.what: total-equity row added for FY2025 (see NSE_SOURCE_CERTIFIED in bot/statements.py): FY2025 472180000.0
corrections.why: the balance sheet on file stopped short of the period the same security's P/E stood on, so the served P/B rested on an older year's book value under a current label; the source's overlapping years match the row on file to the shilling, which is what proves the two sides are the same measure
